nodes.title: Character 1 | Griddle
widgets_values: A completely invented cheerful barbecue dad in his late forties. Short, broad, powerful build with a round expressive face, warm brown skin, a bald head and a compact triangular auburn beard. Wears a brick-red sleeveless utility apron over a cream short-sleeve shirt, navy work trousers, oversized orange heatproof wrist cuffs and dark brown ankle boots. The apron ends above the knees, leaving both legs clearly visible. No hat, handheld utensils, lettering or loose accessories. His low boxing guard and bright grin give him a friendly powerhouse silhouette.

Griddle plants both boots, twists his torso and thrusts one open orange-cuffed palm toward the right, releasing a compact orange-and-gold flame ball. The free hand guards his chest. Keep the fire close to the forward palm so the game can launch a separate projectile; preserve the entire body and both feet inside the sprite cell.
The grill is hot. Your winning streak is toast.

Griddle plants both boots, thrusts both orange-cuffed palms forward toward the right and releases a low rolling wave of orange-and-gold flame that hugs the ground. Keep the flame compact near his palms in sprite art; the game supplies the traveling wave.
Well done. Just how I like my steaks, and my opponents.

With the trophy on the grill shelf, Griddle throws the biggest block party the cul-de-sac has ever seen. Even Baron Bylaw shows up for a plate, and leaves with a recipe card and a smile he swears was only smoke in his eyes.

nodes.title: Character 4 | Nimbus
widgets_values: A completely invented community-garden mom in her mid forties. Medium-height sturdy build, golden-brown skin, a square kind face, a thick cream-colored braid tucked into a short loop at the back of the head, and a determined smile. Plum-purple short-sleeve work coveralls, a broad lavender waist sash with short tucked ends, pale blue fitted forearm cuffs and dark violet rain boots. No plants carried on the body, trailing fabric, watering can, hat, green clothing or lettering. A calm balanced martial-arts stance with open hands.

Nimbus lowers her center of gravity and extends the forward palm toward the right, forming a compact lavender cloud surrounded by pale blue water droplets. The opposite hand remains tucked near the ribs. Confine all droplets near the attacking palm; do not hide the face or crop either rain boot.
I raised a garden. I can handle a little thunder.
Nimbus raises both open palms toward the right and launches a dense lavender storm cloud crackling with pale blue lightning. Keep the cloud compact and attached to her palms in sprite art.
Storms pass. Gardens grow. You lost.
Where the association office once stood, Nimbus plants a community garden. The first sunflower blooms by autumn, and every kid on the street gets a little plot of their own.

nodes.title: Character 6 | Brick
widgets_values: A completely invented neighborhood caretaker granddad in his early sixties. Very tall square heavyweight build, pale freckled skin, a broad rectangular face, flat silver crew cut and thick silver handlebar moustache. Wears a sleeveless rose-red quilted work vest over a charcoal fitted shirt, sand-colored work trousers, simple dark red knuckle wraps and chunky charcoal boots. No tools, cape, hat or lettering. Brick braces his wide stance and drives both wrapped hands forward toward the right, launching one compact rose-red block of energy edged in pale gold. Built to last. You were not.
Brick rebuilds the old playground with his own two hands, plank by plank. When the first kid swings higher than the fence, he finally sits down on the new bench and lets himself grin.

widgets_values:
# REVIEW TEMPLATE: generation is disabled

Run `npm run example:prepare -- --out output/example/<fresh-name>` to create a runnable copy with your local output folder. Open that run's workflow.json. The template deliberately mutes every functional node so opening or queueing an unresolved example cannot start cloud work.

# Comfy Fighter Z: complete arcade example

ONE WORKFLOW: 105 fresh cloud images, 16 silent LTX clips and 99 cloud audio clips, estimated $18.91. Six fictional fighters plus a final boss, 315 poses, 3 arenas, ending art, menu art, UI/effects, a cast ensemble for the startup screen, a looping menu video, one fight introduction per fighter, music, announcer calls and fighter voices. No external image files, real photos, local model weights or opening film.

Run node example/prepare.cjs --out output/example/<fresh-name> to fill your local output folder, then open that run's workflow.json. Edit example/config.json and prepare a new run to keep image and audio descriptions synchronized. Validate and approve the exact cloud spend before queueing. No automatic paid retries.

## One shared output folder

Project Settings supplies the folder to every exporter. The run writes bundle/assets.json, bundle/audio.json, bundle/video.json and their raw/ media. All three arenas are enabled; The Yard also supplies the title and select venue.

Review every fighter sheet and audition the audio. The builder loads the complete bundle and exports a strict self-contained game. A graph is a recipe, not generated artwork.
